import sys

def can_form_words(lengths):
    words = []
    used = set()
    for length in sorted(lengths):
        found = False
        for i in range(2 ** length):
            candidate = bin(i)[2:].zfill(length)
            if all(candidate not in used and not any(candidate.startswith(w) for w in used)):
                words.append(candidate)
                used.add(candidate)
                found = True
                break
        if not found:
            return "NO", []
    return "YES", words

input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
n = int(input[0])
lengths = list(map(int, input[1:]))

result, words = can_form_words(lengths)
print(result)
if result == "YES":
    for word in words:
        print(word)
